description.narrative: The project has established the first mortgage guarantee company in India, the India Mortgage Guarantee Company (IMGC). IMGC will provide partial credit risk coverage in the form of guarantees to mortgage lenders in the event of borrower default.

Status of Operation/Construction: ADB and its partners have provided funding to IMGC. On 30 March 2014, IMGC launched its first mortgage guarantee transaction. As of March 2019, IMGC had signed agreements with 13 clients including State Bank of India, ICICI, Axis Bank, LIC Housing Finance and other housing finance companies. IMGC offers mortgage guarantees (MG) through a) Flow MGs issued on new housing loans at point of origination and b) Bulk MGs providing MGs on lenders' existing housing loan portfolios.
